en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim from his father, both together from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘You have to pay the wergild of the erroneous (killing) within three years, and you have to pay the wergild of the deliberate (killing) within one year’.
